0022600097.text: The Washington Wizards (1-0) host the Toronto Raptors (1-0) in Washington's second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten so far. The Wizards sit 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East, and the Raptors are 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot); the teams have not met yet this season, and their last meeting, on February 28, 2026 in Washington, ended with the Wizards losing 134-125, while the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2.
